meta.note: sender = the informed agent (sees which spot is lit); listener = uninformed partner, hears the sender's 3-token message one step later. slot words = each slot's most common token for that spot. read_back_correct = how often a simple reader (per-slot frequencies) recovers the lit spot from a single message. A delivery respawns the agent elsewhere and re-lights a different spot; an unlit-for-too-long spot also re-rolls. 'idle (k)' = an action with no effect in this world. listener_steps_to_lit_spot = moves needed to stand next to the lit spot (0 = can craft there).
